changelog:
- Initial release of the agent-phasing skill for phased planning of Agent products.
- Introduces a clear 4-phase progressive strategy (P0–P3) based on the One Click methodology.
- For each phase, defines goals, minimal viable scope, key architectural requirements, and strong "do/don't do" guidance.
- Emphasizes building a solid architecture baseline early to avoid future technical debt.
- Documents common pitfalls and gate-based entrance criteria to ensure each phase's health.
- Designed to trigger on user inputs like "Agent 规划", "P0 P1 分期", or when workflow-start routes to this skill.
